Style.ThemeNote: Applies to both Party HUD and Action Menu.
Style.FontNote: Custom fonts for HUD text. Select (Theme Default) to use the theme's default font.
Style.ActionMenuFontNote: Custom font for the Action Menu. Select (Theme Default) to use the theme's default font.
Style.ActionMenuNote: Show floating action buttons when a token is selected.
Style.OwnerOnlyCardsNote: Only show HUD cards to the character's owner and observers. GM always sees all.
Style.SceneFriendlyNPCsNote: Automatically show HUD cards for linked NPCs with Friendly disposition on the current scene. Cards update when scenes change or tokens are added/removed.
Style.OnlinePlayersOnlyNote: Only show cards for characters whose player is currently online. NPCs in the roster are always visible.
Style.DisplayModeNote: When set to 'Selected Token Only', cards appear only when the corresponding token is selected. Falls back to owned characters when nothing is selected.
Style.HudBehindUINote: Display HUD behind Foundry core UI elements (sidebar, hotbar, etc.)
Style.CollapseCardsNote: Collapse cards to portrait-only thumbnails. Hover to expand. (Shift+C to toggle live)
Style.ThemeGMWarning: Only the GM can manage themes.
Style.NoLayers: No layers added. Click 'Add Layer' to create one.
Style.PortraitLayersNote: Add multiple image layers around the portrait. Z-Index controls stacking (Portrait=5). Layers with higher Z appear on top.
Style.CardBgLayersNote: Add multiple image layers behind the card. Z-Index controls stacking. Layers with higher Z appear on top.
Style.ElementImageNote: Default images for bars, dots, and numbers. Per-attribute overrides in Tracking tab.
Style.CardSizeNote: Default size for all cards. Can be overridden per actor.
Style.CardScaleNote: Scale the entire card (e.g., 0.7 for a familiar). Leave at 1.0 for default.
Style.ReduceMotionNote: Disable animations for users sensitive to motion (respects system preference)
